subject: AWS Marketplace listing & co-sell enablement — asset checklist and next steps
messages:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@amazon.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing assets for Redwood Inference — initial request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for partnering with AWS Marketplace — excited to get Redwood listed. To move the listing creation and co-sell enablement along we need a concise set of assets and confirmations from your side. Can you review the checklist below and return items (or let me know if you need more time):

- Final product page copy (short description 1-2 sentences + long description up to 1,000 chars)
- Pricing model: SaaS subscription SKU(s) or metered pricing? If SaaS, confirm monthly/annual tiers and list prices
- Company logo (.png, 512px square) and one short demo video (optional, 30–60s)
- Certificate/SOC2 URL or a copy of attestation for the security field
- Contact for technical onboarding and for co-sell enablement (name/email)
- Any required billing/legal flow notes (reseller vs direct, entitlements)

If we can get the copy and pricing this week, we can target a listing creation by end of next week and then schedule a co-sell enablement call with the AWS sales team. Also flag if you want the listing to be SaaS (hosted by you) or SaaS On AWS (we host) — that determines the technical listing template.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Sam Jenkins
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
(Attachment requested: product page fields template)
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@amazon.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing assets for Redwood Inference — initial request

Hi Sam — thanks, we’re on it. I’ve attached a first-pass product page draft and pricing matrix and answered the checklist inline below.

Inline answers:
- Product page copy: attached (redwood_aws_product_page_draft_v1.docx). Short description + long description included.
- Pricing model: SaaS subscription. Two tiers: Team (monthly $499) and Business (monthly $2,499). Annual discounts in the pricing matrix (redwood_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx).
- Logo: attached (redwood_logo_square_512.png). Demo video: attached (one_min_product_walkthrough.mp4) — note the video is a narrated UI capture, 55s.
- SOC2: public attestation is hosted here: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-report (let me know if you need a PDF copy).
- Contacts: Technical onboarding — Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai). Co-sell/Sales contact — Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai).
- Billing: We want standard SaaS subscription billing via AWS Marketplace (AWS handles invoicing/entitlement). No custom reseller flow required.

Next steps from our side: Rafael is looping in legal for standard Marketplace terms; Marissa will coordinate the co-sell pitch deck and enablement materials. Please confirm whether the listing should be created as a SaaS product (we host) or SaaS On AWS (customer self-service). My preference is standard SaaS listing.

Attachments: redwood_aws_product_page_draft_v1.docx (docx), redwood_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx), redwood_logo_square_512.png (png), one_min_product_walkthrough.mp4 (mp4)

Thanks — happy to adjust copy if you have length constraints.

— Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@amazon.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing assets for Redwood Inference — initial request

Laura — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items before we start creating the listing:

1) Listing template: confirmed — SaaS (hosted by vendor) is fine and the SaaS template is the one we’ll use.
2) Pricing SKUs: we’ll need per-SKU display names and a required metadata field for the SKU ids. Can you add a column in the pricing matrix with ‘marketplace_sku_id’ (we can insert them if you prefer).
3) Video: we accept mp4; we’ll host on the product page. Please confirm we have permission to use the video on the Marketplace listing.
4) Logo: please also provide a 1200x300 banner (png or jpg) if you want the hero banner on the listing — the square logo is fine for thumbnails.
5) Security: SOC2 link is fine; we’ll link it in the security section but we also need the name of the auditor and the date of the report (month/year).

One more ask from the co-sell team: can Marissa provide a 1-paragraph co-sell pitch that we can add to the AWS field ‘Why this solution’, and a single slide with expected partner-ready use cases? That helps the sales field understand the opportunity quickly.

If possible, we’ll create the draft listing by Wednesday and share for final sign-off.

Cheers,
Sam
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace listing assets for Redwood Inference — internal approvals

Forwarding Sam’s note — Marissa, can you draft the 1-paragraph co-sell pitch and a single slide (product-use-cases) by EOD? Monica — can you confirm you’ll be the technical contact on the Marketplace listing and that we can share the video? Markus/Rafael — need quick sign-off on the Team and Business pricing tiers (pricing matrix attached).

Hi Sam and team — sending final assets and the co-sell pitch per your asks. Summary below and links to the files in Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/aws-marketplace/assets

- Co-sell paragraph (for ‘Why this solution’): Redwood Inference provides a production-grade inference platform that makes LLM-powered features predictable and cost-effective at scale. Our unified runtime and cost-aware controls help AWS customers reduce per-token spend while meeting enterprise SLAs, making Redwood a strong partner for embedding generative AI across customer apps.
- Single-slide use-cases: attached as marketplace_usecases_slide.pdf (Drive link above) — highlights: customer support automation, search & summarization pipelines, and personalized recommendation inference.
- Pricing matrix: updated with marketplace_sku_id column.
- Security: SOC2 attestation performed by Brightline Auditors, report dated 2025-11.
- Permissions: Redwood confirms AWS may host the video and use the supplied images on the product page.

Next steps: Please create the draft listing and share the preview for final sign-off. Also cc our sales lead if the co-sell team wants to book an enablement call — HubSpot deal HS-49812 is the record.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(Attachment: marketplace_usecases_slide.pdf; updated_pricing_matrix_with_skus.xlsx)
